mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund ( id, payment_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{paymentId}, #{merchantId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{providerReference}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (payment_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at FROM refund WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
SELECT * FROM refund WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, payment_id, merchant_id, amount, currency, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at FROM refund WHERE id = #{id} AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
